description: A corrected NextItNet cold start for sequential recommendation on four Amazon categories: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Train one independent NextItNet-family model per category and select changes using macro-average validation HR@10. The supplied content specifies an experimental protocol, rather than a new architectural contribution.
motivation: Provide a reproducible starting point for improving NextItNet while preserving benchmark comparability, correct left-padded sequence handling, and consistency between training and deployed prediction.
implementation_notes: Use preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42, with at most 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch. Preserve the supplied splits, all category routes, and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']. Write artifacts beneath the trial directory. Keep the NextItNet backbone family and train exactly one model/checkpoint per category, without ensembles or independently fitted score additions. Read features from the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Keep log2feats(sequence), item_emb, predict_score(features, items), and the host ModelView contract compatible. Update the embedded predictor writer whenever the architecture changes. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps are available. The host independently evaluates validation recommendations; no measured results or baseline source code were supplied.
pseudocode:
set preprocessing_seed = 0 and training_seed = 42
for category in the four required categories:
    load the supplied training split from GAGC_DATA_DIR
    initialize the corrected NextItNet-family baseline
    train one model with epochs <= 200 and batches_per_epoch = 200
    extract sequence features at the final nonpadding position
    save one checkpoint and its architecture configuration under the trial directory
write working/predict.py using matching model definitions and category routing
retain compatible family-specific diagnostic interfaces
have the host evaluate macro-average validation HR@10
select changes using validation results within the shared search budget

originality.positive: Defines concrete safeguards for reproducible family-specific experimentation and checkpoint/predictor consistency.
originality.negative: No novel architecture, objective, or sampling method is described.
